  128: function buildCustomGroupPackage(
  129:   selected: AssessmentInterventionPackage[],
  130: ): AssessmentInterventionPackage | null {
  131:   if (selected.length < 2) return null;
  132: 
  133:   const studentsMap = new Map<string, AssessmentInterventionPackageStudent>();
  134: 
  135:   for (const item of selected) {
  136:     for (const student of item.students) {
  137:       studentsMap.set(student.id, student);
  138:     }
  139:   }

  141:   const students = Array.from(studentsMap.values());
  142:   const subjects = unique(selected.flatMap((item) => item.subjects));

  225:   const record = section && typeof section === "object" ? (section as Record<string, unknown>) : {};
